items.title: Choose a language and read the trust statement on a welcome screen
items.detail: There is no welcome page at /, so nobody sees language selection or the trust statement first. The PRD asks for "Welcome screen: language selection and simple trust statement."
items.note: app/page.tsx now serves a welcome screen at / with the LanguageSelector (components/LanguageSelector.tsx, persisted via lib/language-storage.ts), the trust statement, and a Continue link to /intake; the regional language label is still a placeholder that needs replacing before launch.

items.title: Describe my situation in one short sentence by typing
items.detail: The conversational intake screen at /tell-us-about-your-situation is missing. The PRD asks to "Start with plain language, not a long form."

items.title: Have my typed sentence understood as class, institution, state and income
items.detail: POST /api/my/profiles is missing, so a typed sentence cannot become a profile. The PRD asks to "Extract profile details from the user's message."

items.title: Speak my situation into the microphone and confirm the transcript
items.detail: POST /api/speech-transcriptions is missing, so voice input does not work. The PRD asks to "Include microphone input and typed input."

items.title: Answer 2–4 follow-up questions one at a time and skip optional ones
items.detail: The follow-up flow at /follow-up-question-flow is missing. The PRD asks to "Answer only 2–4 simple follow-up questions" and to "Let users skip optional questions."

items.title: Get the next most useful question, and save or skip each answer
items.detail: The follow-up answer endpoints are missing: next-question, answers, skip and the answers list. Nothing picks the highest-value question or re-checks schemes after an answer.

items.title: See schemes grouped as Likely eligible, May qualify and Not currently eligible
items.detail: The results screen at /results is missing, along with the endpoint that groups results. The PRD asks for "schemes grouped as" these three categories, each with a respectful reason.

items.title: Read why a scheme fit, what still needs checking and why it may not fit
items.detail: The scheme detail screen at /schemes/[id] is missing. The PRD asks for "Why this may fit", "What we still need to verify" and "Why this may not fit" on each result.

items.title: Change one answer and see which scheme changes and which rule caused it
items.detail: The "What changes my result?" interaction is missing: the PATCH endpoint for follow-up answers and the screen that shows previous status and changed rule. The PRD calls it the "CRITICAL DEMO FEATURE."

items.title: Get deterministic eligibility results with reasons for every scheme
items.detail: No rules engine exists, so no result, matched rule or failed rule is ever produced. The PRD requires "Evaluate rules deterministically" and "Never hide decision logic behind AI."

items.title: Browse a curated catalogue of 8–12 verified schemes with rules, documents and steps
items.detail: No scheme data, eligibility rules, required documents or application steps are stored, and the scheme tables are missing. The PRD asks for "exactly 8–12 verified scholarship/education-benefit schemes."

items.title: Save a personalised checklist of documents and steps for a scheme
items.detail: The document checklist and application steps screen is missing, along with the endpoints to save and load a checklist. The PRD asks for a "Personalised document checklist" and "Step-by-step application guide."

items.title: Tick off documents and steps as done on my checklist
items.detail: The tick-off endpoint for checklist items is missing, so a person cannot mark a document or step as done. The PRD asks for a checklist that can be tracked.

items.title: Track each scheme from Not started to Awaiting outcome with a deadline countdown
items.detail: The deadline and progress tracker at /deadline-and-progress-tracker is missing, along with the stage-change endpoints. The PRD asks for "Not started → Documents ready → Applied → Awaiting outcome."

items.title: Get a reminder before a scheme deadline
items.detail: No reminder is sent before a deadline. The PRD asks for a "Deadline countdown/reminder UI" and the plan calls for deadline tracking.

items.title: Share a plain-text checklist summary with family without sensitive details
items.detail: The "Share this checklist with family" button and the summary endpoint are missing. The PRD asks for "a simple shareable text summary, without exposing sensitive details."

items.title: Read the privacy and "How HaqPath decides" explanation
items.detail: The privacy and decision-explanation screen at /privacy-and-how-haqpath-decides is missing. The PRD requires the disclaimer "Final eligibility is decided by the relevant authority."

items.title: Load fictional demo personas with one switch, without typing anything
items.detail: The demo mode screen and the persona list and load endpoints are missing, so judges cannot run the demo without typing. The PRD asks for "A judge-only demo-mode switch with preloaded fictional personas."

items.title: Have results and instructions read aloud
items.detail: No read-aloud control exists on the results, scheme detail or checklist screens. The PRD asks for a "Read-aloud button for results and instructions."

items.title: Switch the whole interface between English and my regional language
items.detail: No language toggle or translated interface text exists. The PRD asks for a "Clear regional-language toggle" and multilingual UI.

items.title: See results, reasons and steps rewritten in simple language
items.detail: The text rewrite endpoints for results, rules, steps and interface text are missing. The PRD asks for "Very simple language."

items.title: Record my relationship to the child and my town for the family record
items.detail: The parent record and its endpoints are missing, so a parent cannot add their relationship or town. The plan lists this as part of the parent persona's flow.

items.title: Start a new check from scratch and clear my earlier answers
items.detail: No reset action exists, so a person cannot clear the session and begin again. The plan lists a reset endpoint for this.
